```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(tmap)

# Load functions 
source(
  here::here(
    "3-scripts",
    "1-functions.r"
  )
)

study_area <- get_study_area()

pbs_sites <- get_wq_sites(study_area)

start_date <- "2005-01-01" # Beginning date of WQ data

end_date <- "2025-01-01" # Ending date of WQ data

force_toggle <- FALSE # TRUE or FALSE, determines if new API download occurs

bin = 2000
```

```{r}

study_map <-
  tm_basemap("Esri.WorldGrayCanvas") +
  tm_shape(study_area) +
  tm_polygons(
    fill_alpha = 0,
    col = "red",
    lwd = 2
  ) +
  tm_layout(
    inner.margins = c(0.2, 0.2, 0.2, 0.2)
  ) +
  tm_title("Pensacola Bay System")

tmap_save(
  tm = study_map,
  filename = here::here(
    "4-tables-and-figures",
    "study_area.png"
  ),
  width = 8,
  height = 6,
  units = "in",
  dpi = 300
)

study_map


```


# Retrieve WQ data using study-area sites and selected parameters

## Chlorophyll-a

```{r}
# Retrieve Data 
chla_raw <- get_sf_wq_data(
  param = "Chlorophyll a, corrected for pheophytin",
  from_date = start_date,
  to_date = end_date,
  sites = pbs_sites,
  study_area = study_area,
  output_name = "chla_raw",
  force = force_toggle
)

```

```{r}
# check that all units are same
table(chla_raw$Result_MeasureUnit)

# inspect data for extreme outliers
view(find_outliers(chla_raw))


```


```{r}
# Process Data
chla_proc <- proc_sf_wq_data(
  wq_data = chla_raw, 
  study_area = study_area,
  output_name = "chla_proc", 
  bin_size = bin)

# Plot Data Distribution
param_means_hist(chla_proc, "Chlorophyll-a (µg/L)", "Chl_a")

# Plot Spatial Distribution
param_means_map(chla_proc, "Chlorophyll-a (µg/L)", "Chl_a")

```

## Water Temperature

```{r}
water_temp_raw <- get_sf_wq_data(
  param = "Temperature, water",
  from_date = start_date,
  to_date = end_date,
  study_area = study_area,
  sites = pbs_sites,
  output_name = "water_temp_raw",
  force = force_toggle
)
```

### Clean Water Temp Data
```{r}
# check units
table(water_temp_raw$Result_MeasureUnit)

#view(find_outliers(water_temp_raw))

# remove extreme outliers
water_temp_raw <- water_temp_raw %>% filter(Result_Measure < 100)
```

### Run Processing Script 
```{r}
water_temp_proc <- proc_sf_wq_data(
  wq_data = water_temp_raw,
  study_area = study_area,
  output_name = "water_temp_proc", 
  bin_size = bin
  ) 

# Plot Data Distribution
param_means_hist(water_temp_proc, "Water Temperature (°C)", "Temp")

# View Spatial Distribution
param_means_map(water_temp_proc, "Water Temperature (°C)", "Temp")

#rm(water_temp_raw)
```

Retrieve Oyster Data:

https://gis.myfwc.com/hosting/rest/services/Open_Data/Oyster_Beds_Statewide/MapServer/17/query?outFields=*&where=1%3D1&f=geojson

```{r}

oyster_reefs <- get_oyster_reefs()

oyster_reefs <- st_transform(oyster_reefs, trg_crs)

tm_basemap("Esri.WorldGrayCanvas") +
    tm_shape(oyster_reefs, bbox = study_area) +
    tm_dots(
      col = "black",
      size = 0.5,
      lwd = 0.5,
      fill.legend = tm_legend(
        title = "PBS Oyster Reefs",
        title.fontface = 2,
        #position = c("left", "bottom"),
        position = tm_pos_out("center", "bottom", pos.h = "center"),
        orientation = "landscape",
        show = TRUE
      )
    ) +
    tm_shape(study_area, bbox = study_area) +
    tm_borders(
      col = "red"
    )
    tm_layout(
      inner.margins = c(0.2, 0.2, 0.2, 0.2)
    ) +
    tm_title("Oyster Beds in Pensacola Bay System", fontface = 2) +
    tm_compass(type = "8star")

saveRDS(oyster_reefs, here::here("2-data", "processed", "oys_proc.rds"))  
```

## Attempt 2 - Random Sampling SDM 

```{r}
set.seed(42)
maxent()

p <- pb %>%
  dplyr::select(pb, geometry) %>%
  dplyr::filter(pb == 1)

b <- pb %>%
  dplyr::select(pb, geometry) %>%
  dplyr::filter(pb == 0)


# withhold 20% for testing
fold_p <- kfold(p, k = 5)
fold_b <- kfold(b, k = 5)

p_test  <- p[fold_p == 1, ]
p_train <- p[fold_p != 1, ]

b_test  <- b[fold_b == 1, ]
b_train <- b[fold_b != 1, ]

# convert to coordinates for model
p_xy <- st_coordinates(p_train)
b_xy <- st_coordinates(b_train)

sdm <- dismo::maxent(
  x = r_stack,
  p = p_xy,
  b = b_xy
)

plot(sdm)

response(sdm)

#test model

p_xy <- st_coordinates(p_test)
b_xy <- st_coordinates(b_test)

eval <- evaluate(p_xy, b_xy, sdm, r_stack)

eval

eval_tbl <- data.frame(
  Metric = c("AUC", "Correlation", "Max TPR + TNR Threshold", "N Presences", "N Absences"),
  Value = c(
    eval@auc,
    eval@cor,
    eval@t[which.max(eval@TPR + eval@TNR)],
    eval@np,
    eval@na
  )
)

knitr::kable(eval_tbl, caption = "Model Evaluation Metrics (Spatial Cross-Validation)")

kfold_pred <- predict(r_stack, sdm)

kfold_pred_df <- as.data.frame(kfold_pred , xy = TRUE) %>% 
  na.omit()

plot(kfold_pred)

map +
  geom_raster(data = kfold_pred_df, aes(x = x, y = y, fill = layer)) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(name = "Suitability") + 
  labs(
    title = "Oyster Habitat Suitability", 
    subtitle = "MaxEnt - K-Folds Sampling Approach", 
      ) + 
  xlab("Longitude") + 
  ylab("Latitude" )

```
